+# Plactic centralizer 峰位猜想的反例：$n=10$
+
+本仓库给出 Sagan–Wilson《Centralizers in the plactic monoid》中峰位猜想的一个精确反例。猜想编号为 [arXiv v1 的 Conjecture 6.3(d)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20460v1)，正式发表版对应 [Conjecture 7.3(d)](https://users.math.msu.edu/users/bsagan/Papers/Old/cpm-pub.pdf#page=19)。
+
+**当 $n=10$ 时，猜想指定的第 $5$ 项并非最大项：**
+
+$$
+a_5=75095<88704=a_6.
+$$
+
+这里的 $a_k$ 是计数多项式在 $\binom{m}{k}$ 基下的系数。完整向量是
+
+$$
+(a_0,\ldots,a_9)
+=(0,1,250,4917,29648,75095,88704,43414,4861,1).
+$$
+
+该反例否定的是上述猜想的 **(d) 峰位断言**。它没有否定系数的对数凹性，也没有解决一般 Kronecker 系数的正组合规则问题。优先权尚未确认；本材料尚未经过外部同行审阅。
+
+## 这个问题在数什么
+
+把正整数排成一个词，用 RSK 行插入算法得到一张 Young 表。两个词得到同一张插入表，就称它们 Knuth 等价；按这种等价关系合并词，便得到 plactic monoid。
+
+考察在词的前面或后面加一个 $1$，插入表仍相同的词：
+
+$$
+C(1)=\{w:1w\equiv w1\},\qquad
+c_{n,m}(1)=\#\{w\in[m]^n:1w\equiv w1\}.
+$$
+
+对固定的 $n$，这个计数是关于字母上界 $m$ 的多项式。原猜想将它写成
+
+$$
+c_{n,m}(1)=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}a_k\binom{m}{k},
+$$
+
+并预测 $a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$ 在 $k=\lceil n/2\rceil$ 取得最大值。$n=10$ 的反例由此只需证明 $a_6>a_5$。
+
+## 证明与核验
+
+[中文完整证明](docs/proof.zh-CN.md) 从已发表的 centralizer 判据和 RSK 双射推导精确计数式，再利用次数上界与十个精确取值确定多项式。全部 $42$ 个分拆的逐项数据保存在 [计数证书](data/n10_tableau_certificate.csv) 中。
+
+三套程序分别使用钩公式、删角与水平条递推，以及直接半标准表枚举与行列式计算。直接枚举覆盖 $n=10$、字母不超过 $6$ 的 **239,316 张半标准表**，对每张表检验插入关系，并按同形标准记录表数加权。这里枚举的是表，而非全部 $6^{10}$ 个词。
+
+也可阅读 [English summary](docs/summary.en.md)。
+
+## 复现
+
+需要 Python 3.10 或更新版本；程序仅使用 Python 标准库。
+
+1. 下载或克隆本仓库。
+2. 在仓库根目录打开终端，运行：
+
+   ```sh
+   python reproduce.py
+   ```
+
+3. 查看运行输出，并核对 `data/` 中的精确系数、计数证书和独立核验记录。
+
+默认运行使用临时目录，不改动 `data/` 中的基线。保留本次输出可运行 `python reproduce.py --output-dir artifacts`；完整复算已保存的 n=2 至 32 扫描可运行 `python reproduce.py --max-n 32`。仓库文件的校验值列于 [SHA256SUMS](SHA256SUMS)。
+
+## 文件结构
+
+```text
+README.md
+reproduce.py
+docs/
+  proof.zh-CN.md                 中文完整证明
+  summary.en.md                 英文摘要
+scripts/
+  coefficients.py               钩长、钩内容公式路线
+  verify_counterexample.py      删角、水平条递推路线
+  independent_tableau_check.py  直接表枚举、行列式路线
+data/
+  n10_tableau_certificate.csv    42 个分拆的逐项证书
+  coefficients.json
+  counterexample_verification.json
+  independent_tableau_check.json
+```
+
+## 归属与 AI 使用说明
+
+原问题、记号和已有判据归属于 Sagan–Wilson 的论文；本仓库的具体内容是 $n=10$ 的反例及可检查的证明和计算材料。定向公开检索尚未确认是否已有相同反例，因而本仓库不主张首次发现。
+
+维护者使用 Codex 辅助探索、整理文稿和编写代码，不同 AI 子代理参与独立核验。这些核验不等同于外部同行审阅。读者可以从完整证明和逐项证书检查结论，也可运行 `python reproduce.py` 重新计算。
+
+原始文献与后续状态见 [references.md](references.md)，BibTeX 见 [references.bib](references.bib)。AI 使用及材料声明见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)，引用本仓库的方法见 [CITATION.md](CITATION.md)。本次发布尚未指定新材料的开放许可证。

+# Sagan–Wilson 峰位猜想的 $n=10$ 反例
+
+本文证明 Sagan–Wilson《Centralizers in the plactic monoid》中的一个具体断言为假：其计数多项式在二项式基下的系数，不总是在 $k=\lceil n/2\rceil$ 取得最大值。反例是
+
+$$
+n=10,\qquad a_5=75095<88704=a_6.
+$$
+
+这是对该峰位断言的否定结果。本文不主张首次发现，也不声称解决系数对数凹性或一般 Kronecker 正组合规则问题；本材料尚未经过外部同行审阅。
+
+## 1. 原问题和记号
+
+直接核查的来源是 Bruce E. Sagan 与 Alexander N. Wilson 的 [arXiv:2410.20460v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20460v1)，§6，Conjecture 6.3(d)。论文发表于 *Semigroup Forum* 110(3), 724–744 (2025)；正式版对应 [Conjecture 7.3(d)](https://users.math.msu.edu/users/bsagan/Papers/Old/cpm-pub.pdf#page=19)。
+
+令 $[m]=\{1,\ldots,m\}$。对词 $w$，记 $P(w)$ 为通常 RSK 行插入算法的插入表。两个词 Knuth 等价，当且仅当它们的插入表相同，记作
+
+$$
+v\equiv w\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad P(v)=P(w).
+$$
+
+词关于这一等价关系取商，得到 plactic monoid。定义
+
+$$
+C(1)=\{w:1w\equiv w1\},\qquad
+c_{n,m}(1)=\#\{w\in[m]^n:1w\equiv w1\}.
+$$
+
+固定 $n$，将关于 $m$ 的计数多项式写成
+
+$$
+c_{n,m}(1)=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}a_k\binom{m}{k}.
+\tag{1}
+$$
+
+原猜想的 (d) 断言：$a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$ 在 $k=\lceil n/2\rceil$ 取得最大值。这里的基底明确为 $\binom{m}{k}$；换成其他二项式基会改变系数，不能混用。
+
+## 2. 一个精确计数式
+
+分拆 $\lambda=(\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\ldots)\vdash n$ 用来描述大小为 $n$ 的 Young 图。标准 Young 表使用 $1,\ldots,n$ 各一次，行和列均严格递增；半标准 Young 表允许重复，行弱增、列严增。记
+
+$$
+f^\lambda=\#\operatorname{SYT}(\lambda),\qquad
+\widehat\lambda=(\lambda_2,\lambda_3,\ldots),
+$$
+
+并令 $N(\eta,q)$ 表示形状 $\eta$、字母在 $[q]$ 中的半标准表数。约定 $N(\varnothing,q)=1$；当 $q=0$ 且 $\eta\ne\varnothing$ 时，$N(\eta,0)=0$。
+
+Sagan–Wilson 已证明的单字母 centralizer 判据（arXiv v1，Theorem 3.2 和 Corollary 3.3）说明：
+
+$$
+w\in C(1)
+\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
+P(w)\text{ 每一列含有 }1
+\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
+P(w)\text{ 的首行全部为 }1.
+\tag{2}
+$$
+
+最后一个等价来自列严增：字母 $1$ 只能位于其所在列的最上方。
+
+**引理。** 对每个 $n\ge1$ 和 $m\ge1$，
+
+$$
+c_{n,m}(1)=\sum_{\lambda\vdash n}
+f^\lambda N(\widehat\lambda,m-1).
+\tag{3}
+$$
+
+**证明。** 固定插入表的形状 $\lambda$。根据 (2)，合法插入表的首行必须全部为 $1$。删去首行，并把剩余的数值都减去 $1$，得到形状 $\widehat\lambda$、字母在 $[m-1]$ 中的半标准表。
+
+反过来，将任意这样的半标准表各项加 $1$，再放回长度为 $\lambda_1$ 的全 $1$ 首行，就得到合法插入表。剩余各项原值均至少为 $2$，因此补回首行自动满足列严增，不增加其他限制。这两个操作互逆。
+
+RSK 将词双射到一对同形状的表：半标准插入表 $P$ 和标准记录表 $Q$。每张合法的 $P$ 恰配有 $f^\lambda$ 张 $Q$。对所有形状求和，即得 (3)。证毕。
+
+这个双射直接证明 (3) 对全部正整数 $m$ 成立。尽管原论文的某些多项式陈述采用 $m\ge n$，这里无需将低 $m$ 的计数当作未经证明的外推。
+
+## 3. 为什么十个精确值足够
+
+对格子 $x=(i,j)$，其钩长为同一行右侧格数、同一列下方格数再加 $1$，记为 $h_\eta(i,j)$。钩长公式和钩内容公式给出
+
+$$
+f^\lambda=\frac{n!}{\prod_{x\in\lambda}h_\lambda(x)},
+\qquad
+N(\eta,m-1)=
+\prod_{(i,j)\in\eta}
+\frac{m-1+j-i}{h_\eta(i,j)}.
+\tag{4}
+$$
+
+右式是关于 $m$ 的有理系数多项式，次数为 $|\eta|$。因此在 $n=10$ 时，(3) 是次数至多 $9$ 的显式多项式。
+
+实际上次数恰为 $9$：只有 $\lambda=(1^{10})$ 的 $\widehat\lambda$ 有 $9$ 格，该项是
+
+$$
+f^{(1^{10})}N((1^9),m-1)=\binom{m-1}{9},
+$$
+
+其最高次系数为 $1/9!$；其余项次数均至多 $8$。
+
+设用 (3)–(4) 得到的多项式为 $F(m)$。若另一个次数至多 $9$ 的多项式 $Q(m)$ 在十个不同点与 $F(m)$ 相同，则 $F-Q$ 有十个根，因而恒为零。这是下文十点证书的逻辑依据；它不依赖对任意 $n$ 的数值归纳。
+
+## 4. $n=10$ 的逐项证书
+
+$10$ 恰有 $42$ 个分拆。[n10_tableau_certificate.csv](../data/n10_tableau_certificate.csv) 为每个分拆列出 $f^\lambda$，以及 $q=0,\ldots,9$ 时的 $N(\widehat\lambda,q)$。逐列按 (3) 加权求和，得到：
+
+| $m$ | $c_{10,m}(1)$ |
+|---:|---:|
+| 1 | 1 |
+| 2 | 252 |
+| 3 | 5670 |
+| 4 | 50820 |
+| 5 | 275010 |
+| 6 | 1086090 |
+| 7 | 3456369 |
+| 8 | 9398925 |
+| 9 | 22677445 |
+| 10 | 49807595 |
+
+定义
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+Q(m)={}&\binom m1+250\binom m2+4917\binom m3
++29648\binom m4\\
+&+75095\binom m5+88704\binom m6
++43414\binom m7+4861\binom m8+\binom m9.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{5}
+$$
+
+将 $m=1,\ldots,10$ 代入 (5)，恰好逐项得到上表。$F,Q$ 的次数均至多 $9$，所以根据第 3 节，
+
+$$
+c_{10,m}(1)=Q(m)
+$$
+
+是多项式恒等式。二项式多项式 $\binom m0,\ldots,\binom m9$ 构成次数至多 $9$ 的多项式空间的一组基，因此 (1) 的系数唯一，且
+
+$$
+(a_0,\ldots,a_9)
+=(0,1,250,4917,29648,75095,88704,43414,4861,1).
+\tag{6}
+$$
+
+于是
+
+$$
+a_6-a_5=88704-75095=13609>0.
+$$
+
+猜想要求 $k=\lceil10/2\rceil=5$ 处取得最大值，而 $a_6>a_5$。因此 Conjecture 6.3(d)，即正式发表版的 Conjecture 7.3(d)，为假。**证毕。**
+
+完整向量还说明该例的唯一最大值位于 $k=6$；但仅 $a_6>a_5$ 就已足以反驳猜想。
+
+## 5. 独立计算如何核对有限算术
+
+证明的依据是上述双射、次数界和精确证书。程序用于复核有限算术，三条路线分别为：
+
+1. **钩公式。** [coefficients.py](../scripts/coefficients.py) 使用 (3)–(4) 和精确有理数，生成二项式基系数。
+2. **分支递推。** [verify_counterexample.py](../scripts/verify_counterexample.py) 以删角递推标准表数，以水平条分支递推半标准表数，不使用钩长或钩内容公式。所得 $42$ 行证书及十个加权计数与第 4 节一致。
+3. **直接枚举及行列式。** [independent_tableau_check.py](../scripts/independent_tableau_check.py) 枚举 $n=10$、字母不超过 $6$ 的全部 **239,316 张半标准表**，不预先用“首行全为 $1$”筛选。对每张表的标准 row word $w$，直接比较 $P(1w)$ 与 $P(w1)$，再乘同形标准记录表数，得到相同的 $c_{10,m}(1)$，$1\le m\le6$。这枚举的是插入表，而非全部词。该程序另外使用 Jacobi–Trudi 公式及标准表数的行列式，在 $m=10,\ldots,19$ 上精确求解二项式基系数，重新得到 (6)。

+# A counterexample to the peak-location conjecture for plactic centralizers
+
+For $n=10$, the binomial-basis coefficients of the plactic centralizer counting polynomial satisfy
+
+$$
+a_5=75095<88704=a_6.
+$$
+
+This disproves Conjecture 6.3(d) of Sagan and Wilson, [*Centralizers in the plactic monoid*, arXiv:2410.20460v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20460v1), numbered [Conjecture 7.3(d) in the published version](https://users.math.msu.edu/users/bsagan/Papers/Old/cpm-pub.pdf#page=19). Priority has not been established, and this material has not received external peer review.
+
+Let $P(w)$ denote the RSK row-insertion tableau of a word. Knuth equivalence is characterized by $v\equiv w$ if and only if $P(v)=P(w)$. Define
+
+$$
+c_{n,m}(1)=\#\{w\in[m]^n:1w\equiv w1\}
+=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}a_k\binom{m}{k}.
+$$
+
+The conjecture predicts a maximum of $a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$ at $k=\lceil n/2\rceil$.
+
+The authors' established centralizer criterion says that $w$ commutes with $1$ exactly when the first row of $P(w)$ consists entirely of $1$s. For $\lambda\vdash n$, write $\widehat\lambda=(\lambda_2,\lambda_3,\ldots)$ and let $f^\lambda$ count standard Young tableaux. Removing the first row and subtracting $1$ from the remaining entries gives
+
+$$
+c_{n,m}(1)=\sum_{\lambda\vdash n}f^\lambda
+s_{\widehat\lambda}(1^{m-1}),\qquad m\ge1.
+$$
+
+RSK supplies the factor $f^\lambda$ through its standard recording tableaux. The hook-content formula makes the right-hand side a polynomial of degree at most $n-1$; for $n=10$, its degree is exactly $9$.
+
+Summing over all $42$ partitions of $10$ gives the following values at $m=1,\ldots,10$:
+
+$$
+(1,252,5670,50820,275010,1086090,3456369,9398925,22677445,49807595).
+$$
+
+The degree-$9$ polynomial with binomial-basis coefficient vector
+
+$$
+(a_0,\ldots,a_9)
+=(0,1,250,4917,29648,75095,88704,43414,4861,1)
+$$
+
+matches these ten values. Polynomial uniqueness therefore proves the identity. In particular, $a_6-a_5=13609>0$, contradicting the predicted maximum at $k=5$.
+
+The repository includes a [42-row exact certificate](../data/n10_tableau_certificate.csv) and three standard-library Python verifiers: hook formulas; corner and horizontal-strip recurrences; and direct tableau enumeration together with determinant formulas. The last verifier enumerates all **239,316 semistandard tableaux** of size $10$ over an alphabet of size at most $6$, tests the insertion relation directly, and weights each accepted insertion tableau by its number of standard recording tableaux. It also independently recovers the coefficients using $m=10,\ldots,19$.
+
+From the repository root, run:
+
+```sh
+python reproduce.py
+```
+
+The [complete Chinese proof](proof.zh-CN.md) explains the bijection, degree bound, exact arithmetic, and verification scope. This result refutes only the peak-location assertion; it does not refute the separate log-concavity conjecture or solve the general positive combinatorial rule problem for Kronecker coefficients.
+
+The maintainer used Codex for exploration, writing, and code, with checks by separate AI subagents. Those checks are not external peer review.

+"""Exact tableau computation of c_{n,m}(1) and its two binomial expansions.
+
+The input theorem is Sagan--Wilson's characterization: every column of P(w)
+contains 1. Thus the first row consists entirely of ones and all other entries
+are >1. RSK gives c = sum_{lambda|-n} f^lambda s_{tail(lambda)}(1^(m-1)).
+This is an oracle for experiments, not a proof of any log-concavity conjecture.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from fractions import Fraction
+import json
+from math import comb, factorial
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+
+
+BASIS = {
+    "a": "c_n(m) = sum(a[k] * binomial(m,k), k=0,...,n-1)",
+    "b": "c_n(m) = sum(b[k] * binomial(m-1,k), k=0,...,n-1)",
+}
+
+
+def require(condition, detail):
+    if not condition:
+        raise AssertionError(detail)
+
+
+def partitions(n, maximum=None):
+    if n == 0:
+        yield ()
+        return
+    maximum = n if maximum is None else min(maximum, n)
+    for first in range(maximum, 0, -1):
+        for tail in partitions(n - first, first):
+            yield (first,) + tail
+
+
+def hook_product(shape):
+    result = 1
+    for i, width in enumerate(shape):
+        for j in range(width):
+            result *= width-j + sum(row > j for row in shape)-i-1
+    return result
+
+
+def differences(values):
+    answer = []
+    while values:
+        answer.append(values[0])
+        values = [b-a for a, b in zip(values, values[1:])]
+    return answer
+
+
+def compute(n):
+    values = [Fraction(0)] * (n+1)
+    ftotal = factorial(n)
+    shape_count = 0
+    for shape in partitions(n):
+        shape_count += 1
+        dimension = Fraction(ftotal, hook_product(shape))
+        require(dimension.denominator == 1, ("nonintegral dimension", shape))
+        dim = dimension.numerator
+        tail = shape[1:]
+        denominator = hook_product(tail)
+        contents = [j-i for i, width in enumerate(tail) for j in range(width)]
+        for m in range(n+1):
+            numerator = dim
+            for content in contents:
+                numerator *= m-1+content
+                if numerator == 0:
+                    break
+            values[m] += Fraction(numerator, denominator)
+    require(all(v.denominator == 1 for v in values), ("nonintegral counts", n))
+    vals = [v.numerator for v in values]
+    a = differences(vals)
+    b = differences(vals[1:])
+    require(a[-1] == 0 and a[0] == 0 and a[1] == 1, ("degree/constant/linear checks", n))
+    a = a[:-1]
+    require(a[-1] == 1, ("leading binomial coefficient", n))
+    require(all(x > 0 for x in a[1:]), ("nonpositive a", n))
+    require(all(x >= 0 for x in b), ("negative b", n))
+    require(len(a) == len(b) == n, ("basis vector lengths", n))
+    for m, value in enumerate(vals):
+        require(sum(a[k] * comb(m, k) for k in range(n) if k <= m) == value,
+                ("binomial(m,k) reconstruction", n, m))
+        if m >= 1:
+            require(sum(b[k] * comb(m-1, k) for k in range(n) if k < m) == value,
+                    ("binomial(m-1,k) reconstruction", n, m))
+    a_failures = [k for k in range(2, len(a)-1)
+                  if a[k]**2 < a[k-1]*a[k+1]]
+    b_failures = [k for k in range(1, len(b)-1)
+                  if b[k]**2 < b[k-1]*b[k+1]]
+    peak = max(a)
+    peaks = [k for k, value in enumerate(a) if value == peak]
+    return dict(n=n, partitions=shape_count, a=a, b=b,
+                a_log_concavity_failures=a_failures,
+                b_log_concavity_failures=b_failures,
+                a_peak_indices=peaks,
+                expected_peak_attained=(n+1)//2 in peaks,
+                values_m_0_to_n=vals)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--max-n", type=int, default=10, choices=range(2, 33))
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path,
+                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"data"/"generated")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    rows = []
+    for n in range(2, args.max_n+1):
+        row = compute(n)
+        rows.append(row)

+                           "expected_peak_attained"]}), flush=True)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent exact review of Sagan--Wilson Conjecture 6.3(d), n=10.
+
+Enumerate ALL SSYT of
+size 10 over [6], without filtering the first row, then test commutation by
+two direct row insertions.  Obtain the binomial(m,k) coefficients separately
+by Jacobi--Trudi determinants evaluated at m=10,...,19 and exact interpolation.
+The standard-tableau weights use a factorial-reciprocal determinant, not the
+hook-content formula or corner recursion.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from bisect import bisect_right
+from fractions import Fraction
+from functools import cache
+import json
+from math import comb, factorial
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+
+
+Partition = tuple[int, ...]
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, detail: object) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise AssertionError(detail)
+
+
+@cache
+def partitions(n: int, maximum: int | None = None) -> tuple[Partition, ...]:
+    if n == 0:
+        return ((),)
+    maximum = n if maximum is None else min(n, maximum)
+    return tuple((a,) + tail for a in range(maximum, 0, -1)
+                 for tail in partitions(n - a, a))
+
+
+def determinant(matrix: list[list[Fraction]]) -> Fraction:
+    work = [row[:] for row in matrix]
+    answer = Fraction(1)
+    for col in range(len(work)):
+        pivot = next((r for r in range(col, len(work)) if work[r][col]), None)
+        if pivot is None:
+            return Fraction(0)
+        if pivot != col:
+            work[col], work[pivot] = work[pivot], work[col]
+            answer = -answer
+        value = work[col][col]
+        answer *= value
+        for row in range(col + 1, len(work)):
+            multiplier = work[row][col] / value
+            for j in range(col + 1, len(work)):
+                work[row][j] -= multiplier * work[col][j]
+    return answer
+
+
+@cache
+def standard_tableau_count(shape: Partition) -> int:
+    # f^lambda = n! det(1/(lambda_i-i+j)!).  A negative factorial means zero.
+    matrix = [[Fraction(1, factorial(shape[i] - i + j))
+               if shape[i] - i + j >= 0 else Fraction(0)
+               for j in range(len(shape))] for i in range(len(shape))]
+    result = factorial(sum(shape)) * determinant(matrix)
+    require(result.denominator == 1 and result > 0, ("standard-tableau determinant", shape, result))
+    return result.numerator
+
+
+def row_insertion(word: tuple[int, ...]) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
+    rows: list[list[int]] = []
+    for letter in word:
+        carry = letter
+        for row in rows:
+            position = bisect_right(row, carry)
+            if position == len(row):
+                row.append(carry)
+                break
+            row[position], carry = carry, row[position]
+        else:
+            rows.append([carry])
+    return tuple(tuple(row) for row in rows)
+
+
+def direct_tableau_counts(n: int = 10, max_m: int = 6) -> dict:
+    exact_max_weighted = [0] * (max_m + 1)
+    exact_max_all_tableaux = [0] * (max_m + 1)
+    per_shape = []
+    all_tableaux = first_row_predicate_disagreements = commuting_tableaux = 0
+    for shape in partitions(n):
+        if len(shape) > max_m:
+            per_shape.append({"partition": list(shape), "f_lambda": standard_tableau_count(shape),
+                              "all_ssyt": 0, "commuting_ssyt": 0})
+            continue
+        positions = tuple((row, col) for row, width in enumerate(shape) for col in range(width))
+        cell_indices = {cell: index for index, cell in enumerate(positions)}
+        above = [cell_indices.get((row - 1, col)) for row, col in positions]
+        left = [cell_indices.get((row, col - 1)) for row, col in positions]
+        reading_order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda k: (-positions[k][0], positions[k][1]))
+        entries = [0] * n
+        weight = standard_tableau_count(shape)
+        shape_total = shape_commuting = 0
+
+        def visit(index: int) -> None:
+            nonlocal all_tableaux, first_row_predicate_disagreements, commuting_tableaux
+            nonlocal shape_total, shape_commuting
+            if index == n:
+                all_tableaux += 1
+                shape_total += 1
+                maximum = max(entries)
+                exact_max_all_tableaux[maximum] += 1
+                word = tuple(entries[k] for k in reading_order)
+                commutes = row_insertion((1,) + word) == row_insertion(word + (1,))
+                first_row_ones = all(letter == 1 for letter in entries[:shape[0]])
+                first_row_predicate_disagreements += commutes != first_row_ones
+                if commutes:
+                    commuting_tableaux += 1
+                    shape_commuting += 1
+                    exact_max_weighted[maximum] += weight
+                return
+            minimum = 1
+            if left[index] is not None:
+                minimum = max(minimum, entries[left[index]])
+            if above[index] is not None:
+                minimum = max(minimum, entries[above[index]] + 1)
+            for letter in range(minimum, max_m + 1):
+                entries[index] = letter
+                visit(index + 1)
+
+        visit(0)
+        per_shape.append({"partition": list(shape), "f_lambda": weight,
+                          "all_ssyt": shape_total, "commuting_ssyt": shape_commuting})
+    require(first_row_predicate_disagreements == 0, "commutation/first-row predicate disagreement")
+    # Independent total from sum_lambda s_lambda(1^m): coefficient of
+    # (1-t)^(-m) (1-t^2)^(-m(m-1)/2).
+    total_formula = sum(comb(max_m + n - 2 * j - 1, n - 2 * j)
+                        * comb(max_m * (max_m - 1) // 2 + j - 1, j)
+                        for j in range(n // 2 + 1))
+    require(all_tableaux == total_formula, ("all SSYT total", all_tableaux, total_formula))
+    values = [sum(exact_max_weighted[:m + 1]) for m in range(max_m + 1)]
+    return {"n": n, "max_m": max_m, "all_ssyt_enumerated": all_tableaux,
+            "independent_all_ssyt_total": total_formula,
+            "commuting_ssyt_unweighted": commuting_tableaux,
+            "first_row_predicate_disagreements": first_row_predicate_disagreements,
+            "exact_max_tableaux_counts": exact_max_all_tableaux,
+            "exact_max_commuting_word_counts": exact_max_weighted,
+            "c_n_m_for_m_0_through_6": values, "per_shape": per_shape}
+
+
+def h_specialization(degree: int, alphabet_size: int) -> Fraction:
+    if degree < 0:
+        return Fraction(0)
+    if degree == 0:
+        return Fraction(1)
+    return Fraction(comb(alphabet_size + degree - 1, degree))
+
+
+def jacobi_trudi_count(shape: Partition, alphabet_size: int) -> int:
+    matrix = [[h_specialization(shape[i] - i + j, alphabet_size)
+               for j in range(len(shape))] for i in range(len(shape))]
+    result = determinant(matrix)
+    require(result.denominator == 1 and result >= 0, ("Jacobi-Trudi", shape, alphabet_size, result))
+    return result.numerator
+
+
+def solve(matrix: list[list[Fraction]], values: list[int]) -> list[Fraction]:
+    size = len(matrix)
+    work = [row[:] + [Fraction(value)] for row, value in zip(matrix, values)]
+    for col in range(size):
+        pivot = next((r for r in range(col, size) if work[r][col]), None)
+        require(pivot is not None, ("interpolation singular", col))
+        work[col], work[pivot] = work[pivot], work[col]
+        divisor = work[col][col]
+        work[col] = [value / divisor for value in work[col]]
+        for row in range(size):
+            if row != col:
+                multiplier = work[row][col]
+                work[row] = [a - multiplier * b for a, b in zip(work[row], work[col])]
+    answer = [row[-1] for row in work]
+    require(all(sum(a * b for a, b in zip(row, answer)) == value
+                for row, value in zip(matrix, values)), "interpolation reconstruction")
+    return answer
+
+
+def independent_polynomial(n: int = 10) -> dict:
+    arguments = list(range(n, 2 * n))
+    values = [sum(standard_tableau_count(shape)
+                  * jacobi_trudi_count(shape[1:], m - 1) for shape in partitions(n))
+              for m in arguments]
+    matrix = [[Fraction(comb(m, k)) for k in range(n)] for m in arguments]
+    coefficients = solve(matrix, values)
+    require(all(value.denominator == 1 for value in coefficients), "nonintegral coefficient")
+    return {"n": n, "interpolation_m_values": arguments,
+            "c_n_m_at_interpolation_values": values,
+            "basis": "binomial(m,k), k=0,...,9; NOT binomial(m-1,k)",
+            "method": "Jacobi-Trudi determinant for s_tail(1^(m-1)); reciprocal-factorial determinant for f_lambda; interpolate only at m>=n.",
+            "coefficients_a_0_through_9": [value.numerator for value in coefficients]}
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path,
+                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"data"/"generated")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    direct = direct_tableau_counts()
+    polynomial = independent_polynomial()
+    coefficients = polynomial["coefficients_a_0_through_9"]
+    low_values = direct["c_n_m_for_m_0_through_6"]
+    for m, value in enumerate(low_values):
+        reconstructed = sum(coefficients[k] * comb(m, k) for k in range(min(m, 9) + 1))
+        require(reconstructed == value, ("direct/tableau-polynomial mismatch", m, reconstructed, value))
+    # Newton differences of the DIRECT values are checked only after the
+    # independently interpolated polynomial is shown to agree even at m=0.
+    differences = low_values[:]
+    first_differences = []
+    while differences:

+"""Independent exact certificate for the n=10 peak-position counterexample.
+
+No hook-length or hook-content formula is used here. Standard tableaux are
+counted by corner removal; semistandard tableaux by horizontal-strip branching.
+A further direct word-insertion check covers small cases.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from functools import cache
+from itertools import product
+import csv
+import json
+from math import comb
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def partitions(n, maximum=None):
+    if n == 0:
+        yield ()
+    else:
+        maximum = n if maximum is None else min(maximum, n)
+        for first in range(maximum, 0, -1):
+            for tail in partitions(n-first, first):
+                yield (first,) + tail
+
+
+@cache
+def standard_count(shape):
+    if not shape:
+        return 1
+    total = 0
+    for i, width in enumerate(shape):
+        if i+1 == len(shape) or width > shape[i+1]:
+            predecessor = list(shape)
+            predecessor[i] -= 1
+            total += standard_count(tuple(x for x in predecessor if x))
+    return total
+
+
+@cache
+def horizontal_predecessors(shape):
+    """All mu with shape/mu a horizontal strip, including the empty strip."""
+    ranges = [range(shape[i+1] if i+1 < len(shape) else 0, width+1)
+              for i, width in enumerate(shape)]
+    return tuple(tuple(x for x in parts if x) for parts in product(*ranges))
+
+
+@cache
+def semistandard_count(shape, alphabet):
+    if alphabet == 0:
+        return int(not shape)
+    return sum(semistandard_count(mu, alphabet-1)
+               for mu in horizontal_predecessors(shape))
+
+
+def c(n, m):
+    assert m >= 1
+    return sum(standard_count(shape)*semistandard_count(shape[1:], m-1)
+               for shape in partitions(n))
+
+
+def insertion(word):
+    rows = []
+    for value in word:
+        for row in rows:
+            for j, old in enumerate(row):
+                if old > value:
+                    row[j], value = value, old
+                    break
+            else:
+                row.append(value)
+                break
+        else:
+            rows.append([value])
+    return tuple(tuple(row) for row in rows)
+
+
+def coefficient(values, k):
+    return sum((-1)**(k-j)*comb(k, j)*values[j] for j in range(k+1))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path,
+                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"data"/"generated")
+    parser.add_argument("--coefficients", type=Path,
+                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"data"/"coefficients.json")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if not __debug__:
+        parser.error("Run Python without -O or -OO so all verification assertions execute")
+    root = args.output_dir
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    previous = json.loads(args.coefficients.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    rows_by_n = {row["n"]: row for row in previous["rows"]}
+    branch_checks = 0
+    for n in range(2, 11):
+        values = [0] + [c(n, m) for m in range(1, n+1)]
+        assert values == rows_by_n[n]["values_m_0_to_n"], (n, values)
+        a = [coefficient(values, k) for k in range(n)]
+        assert a == rows_by_n[n]["a"]
+        branch_checks += n
+
+    word_checks = []
+    total_words = 0
+    for n in range(1, 7):
+        for m in range(1, 5):
+            actual = 0
+            characterization_count = 0
+            for word in product(range(1, m+1), repeat=n):
+                total_words += 1
+                left, right = insertion((1,)+word), insertion(word+(1,))
+                commutes = left == right
+                tableau = insertion(word)
+                first_row_ones = all(letter == 1 for letter in tableau[0])
+                assert commutes == first_row_ones, (word, left, right)
+                actual += commutes
+                characterization_count += first_row_ones
+            predicted = c(n, m)
+            assert actual == characterization_count == predicted
+            word_checks.append(dict(n=n, m=m, c=actual))
+
+    values = [0] + [c(10, m) for m in range(1, 11)]
+    a = [coefficient(values, k) for k in range(10)]
+    assert a == [0, 1, 250, 4917, 29648, 75095, 88704, 43414, 4861, 1]
+    assert a[6] > a[5] and a.index(max(a)) == 6
+    assert coefficient(values, 10) == 0
+
+    # Forty-two individual tableau-shape contributions certify every value
+    # c(10,m), m=1,...,10, without invoking either hook formula.
+    certificate = []
+    for shape in partitions(10):
+        f = standard_count(shape)
+        counts = [semistandard_count(shape[1:], q) for q in range(10)]
+        row = {"shape": ",".join(map(str, shape)), "f_lambda": f}
+        row.update({f"ssyt_tail_alphabet_{q}": count
+                    for q, count in enumerate(counts)})
+        certificate.append(row)
+    with (root/"n10_tableau_certificate.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8",
+                                                  newline="") as handle:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(certificate[0]))
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(certificate)
+    for m in range(1, 11):
+        assert sum(r["f_lambda"]*r[f"ssyt_tail_alphabet_{m-1}"]
+                   for r in certificate) == values[m]
+
+    # Degree <=9 follows from |tail(lambda)|<=9. Zero constant term follows
+    # from the hook-shape alternating binomial identity, explained in the proof.
+    result = dict(
+        status="passed",
+        conjecture="Sagan-Wilson arXiv:2410.20460 Conjecture 6.3(d); journal 7.3(d)",
+        n=10, predicted_peak=5, actual_unique_peak=6, a=a,
+        difference_a6_minus_a5=a[6]-a[5],
+        values_m_0_to_10=values,
+        independent_method="Corner recursion for f; horizontal-strip recursion for SSYT; no hook formulas",
+        matched_values_n2_to_10=branch_checks,
+        certificate_partitions=len(certificate),
+        direct_word_tests=total_words,
+        direct_word_cases=word_checks,
+        polynomial_degree_upper_bound=9,
+        novelty="No priority conclusion is established by this program.",
+        scope="Only the prescribed peak location is refuted; no log-concavity or first-discovery conclusion.",
+    )
+    (root/"counterexample_verification.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ["status", "n", "a",
+                     "predicted_peak", "actual_unique_peak",
+                     "difference_a6_minus_a5", "certificate_partitions",
+                     "direct_word_tests"]}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
